# Mini Season: Sunset Stranger Challenges and Guides

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 23, 2025
- 5 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_66166d9cb7e0422f8f5ca0c8bde6a410~mv2.jpg)

The Sunset Stranger Mini Season is a limited-time event in Fallout 76.

Running from **23rd December 2025** to **6th January 2026** at 12 PM US EST (at Atom Shop changeover), players can claim the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat for free from the Mini Seasons Board.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_1d087b8e8ead4631a0810d9a0878f4d7~mv2.jpg)

To participate, head to an Armor Workbench, craft the Sunset Sarsaparilla Deputy Hat, and equip it on your character. Then, complete the listed challenges to earn exclusive, limited-time rewards.

**Limited-Time Challenges have been reworked and are now called Mini Seasons**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_4a525b4c9cd54f34a5eeb041f4332a3c~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2cec867de1174cfe8f62335407212b89~mv2.png)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_84592acd325443a3ae6484ae1d7c27c6~mv2.jpg)

**How it works:**

Complete each challenge to earn tickets, which can then be used to purchase the rewards of your choice from the limited-time reward board. This system works similarly to the current Season structure.

At the time of publishing this guide, the exact number of tickets awarded per challenge—and the ticket cost of each reward—has not yet been confirmed.

__FAQ__

**Can we re-roll the challenges?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a custom server?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a private server, by myself, if I create a public team?**

Yes.

**Can I complete these challenges in one day?**

Yes, all the challenges for the week will be released on the first day, allowing you a week to complete them.

**Can I wear Power Armor while completing these challenges?**

**Yes!** — The challenge has been updated so that as long as you have the hat equipped, it will count. This means you can now complete the challenge without exiting Power Armor or removing your helmet. 

**Can I still get intoxicated if I am a Ghoul?**

Yes, you can.

**Can I complete the challenges on different characters?**

Yes. As long as you are on the same account and the character has the required item equipped, you can spread the challenges across multiple characters.

**Why can’t I lock the rewards when I have enough tickets?**

You need to claim and unlock rewards in a specific order; you can’t just pick and choose which ones to claim. If you hover over a reward, it will show you which items you need to claim first before it becomes available.
